_comment: Maps each dashboard platform to the workbook sheet(s)/block(s) that hold its monthly data. 'header_row' is the row number (1-indexed) of the block's own header row (the row containing 'Total Storage' / 'Month' / ... labels) inside the given sheet -- this uniquely identifies a block when a sheet contains more than one (e.g. 'EQUINIX DC'). Edit this file to reclassify a site or add a new one; no code changes needed.

sites._note: Grouped with the Oracle blocks in the source sheet; confirm this belongs under Oracle ZFS rather than FlashStack and move it in this file if not.
